name: Sarzamine Sabz
overview: Reza and Farid, who have lost their wives Atefeh and Leyli, find themselves displaced when the Green House is destroyed, and in this displacement they visit different parts of Iran. They become familiar with the stories of the Azeris, the Southerners, and the Baluchis, and ultimately realize that even if the Green House is destroyed, the Green Land still stands.
